svg.desc: Weekly rows with a missing week: a ROWS 3 PRECEDING frame takes four rows and reaches five weeks back, while a RANGE 21 DAY PRECEDING frame stays within four weeks and takes three rows.

svg.text: For a feature defined in time ("last 4 weeks"), RANGE is the correct frame.
